role: LABELED_COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_CENTRAL: Labeled no-ACC II counterfactual (rollback complement of the expert central's stated-policy continuation): every state, the 13 ACC II adopters included, is re-fitted as an unconstrained no-mandate logistic capped by the fastest observed state path (NV, ratcheted monotone). COUNTERFACTUAL_NO_MANDATE_NOT_A_CENTRAL — a scenario complement, never a central, never a forecast; 19 entries -- 18 states and the District of Columbia -- have no turning point by 2075 (reported, never imputed).

right_censoring.policy: REPORTED_NEVER_IMPUTED: 19 entries -- 18 states and the District of Columbia -- have no sustained-nonincrease onset by 2075 under the no-mandate counterfactual; their onset years are packaged as NaN (displayed '>2075'), never filled with 2075.

conditional_band.note: No conditional prediction band is registered for the no-ACC II counterfactual; bands stay registered for the expert-central v2.2 and policy-central lines only and none is transferred or fabricated here.

boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.grid_boundary: eGRID2023 state generation attributional direct CO2; not delivered-electricity mix, marginal emissions, or a forecast

boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.direct_co2_estimand: scope-matched operational direct CO2: eGRID state total-output attributional electricity CO2 plus EPA gasoline tailpipe CO2; upstream, non-CO2 and embodied terms excluded
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.claim_boundary: deterministic comparative scenarios, not empirical forecasts, causal policy effects, city or urban-rural estimands, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates
